# SystemInfo

Battery and memory facts (Unity: SystemInfo).

Availability: **PSX** no | **PSP** yes | **PS2** no

The component or type needs the `battery` feature (battery level and charging state). If it is missing: do not branch on battery.

Sizes follow Unity: the `*Size` getters are in megabytes; `usedMemory` and `usedGraphicsMemory` are in bytes. 0 or -1 mean unknown.

## Members

| Member | PSX | PSP | PS2 | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `static Scalar batteryLevel()` | no | yes | no | 0 to 1, or -1 when unknown. |
| `static BatteryStatus batteryStatus()` | no | yes | no | `Unknown`, `Charging`, `Discharging`, `NotCharging`, `Full`. |
| `static int systemMemorySize()` | yes | yes | yes | Total RAM in MB. 0 = unknown. |
| `static int graphicsMemorySize()` | yes | yes | yes | Video memory in MB. 0 = unknown. |
| `static u32 usedMemory()` | yes | yes | yes | Bytes the game has in use (the arena). |
| `static u32 usedGraphicsMemory()` | yes | yes | yes | Bytes of video memory in use (buffers and textures). |

## Limits

| Limit | PSX | PSP | PS2 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Device RAM limit (bytes, 0 = not checked) | 2097152 | 33554432 | 0 |

## Notes

- On the PSP the numbers describe the arena the engine made from the pack's ConsoleTarget, not the kernel's free memory: the engine takes almost all of RAM at boot.

## Example

```cpp
Debug::Log("ram %u of %d MB", SystemInfo::usedMemory(), SystemInfo::systemMemorySize());
if (SystemInfo::batteryLevel() >= 0 && SystemInfo::batteryLevel() < 0.1f) showLowBattery();
```
